Paper accepted for EuroVis 2012

The full paper "Interactive Visualization of Generalized Virtual 3D City Models using Level-of-Abstraction Transitions" by Amir Semmo, Matthias Trapp, Jan Eric Kyprianidis and Jürgen Döllner has been accepted as a contribution to the 14th annual Eurographics Conference on Visualization (EuroVis 2012). Their work will be presented at the conference held in Vienna from 5th to 8th June 2012. Moreover, the paper will be published in the conference proceedings which will appear as a special issue of the Computer Graphics Forum.
